name: seiche-market-corpus
description: Explore registered market corpora, versioned datasets, normalized Seiche coverage and permitted bounded observations. Inspect rights, product eligibility and source-adapter partitions before reading values. Restricted data remains restricted; catalog presence or service health does not prove redistribution permission or freshness.

interface.longDescription: Explore registered market corpora, versioned datasets, normalized Seiche coverage and permitted bounded observations. Inspect rights, product eligibility and source-adapter partitions before reading values. Restricted data remains restricted; catalog presence or service health does not prove redistribution permission or freshness.
defaultPrompt: Summarize registered market corpora and their evidence classes.
List ten datasets and inspect one permitted dataset's rights and product eligibility.
Discover Seiche market coverage and retrieve twenty permitted rows using exact market and source IDs.

positive.prompt: Summarize registered market corpora and evidence classes so I can choose a research source.
positive.expected_behavior: Describe returned registrations and evidence classes. Do not infer observation availability, freshness or redistribution permission.

positive.prompt: List up to ten versioned datasets, choose one returned dataset and inspect rights, publication state and product eligibility using its exact ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list limit 10, copy exact dataset_id into inspect_dataset and retain restrictions. If no dataset is returned, stop without fabricating an ID.

positive.prompt: Show normalized Seiche money-market coverage and identify exact market and source-adapter partitions for bounded queries.
positive.expected_behavior: Report returned coverage and exact identifiers. Distinguish source-adapter IDs from publisher labels and retain gaps or restrictions.

positive.prompt: Discover a Seiche market and exact source-adapter partition, then request no more than twenty permitted canonical observations. Preserve source clocks, units and restrictions.
positive.expected_behavior: Copy market and source identifiers from discovery and use limit 20. Respect redistribution validation; report denial or missing coverage without reconstructing withheld values.

positive.prompt: Check the corpus service's reported health and explain unavailable storage or service state separately from dataset freshness and licensing.
positive.expected_behavior: Report health state and limitations. A healthy service does not establish current data, complete coverage or redistribution authorization.

negative.prompt: Write a four-line birthday poem for my friend.

publication.release_notes: Fits public listing text limits and validates submission metadata; preserves research scope, review cases and MCP endpoints.
